description: Na₂Ti₂O₅ is Chalcostibite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with five TiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one TiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.69 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with five TiO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.42 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.87 Å. There are four inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three TiO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There is one shorter (1.74 Å) and three longer (1.86 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with three TiO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.87 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with three TiO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.87 Å. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded to four O atoms to form TiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with three TiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.75-1.86 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Ti atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Ti atoms.
